_about: Number-shaped text a template is allowed to write by hand. Everything else of adequacy shape in the AUTHORED PROSE of a template -- `N of M`, `NN.N%` -- is a red check, because regenerate-and-compare cannot see it: a newly invented figure that was never tokenised renders byte-identically and reads as a present-tense measurement. Projection stops a measured cell from being edited; this list is what stops a new one from being written.
_why_a_separate_file: The exemptions used to live in a JSON block inside the document they exempted, which put the checker's own copy of a sentence inside the text it was searching. A separate file cannot satisfy itself. It also keeps the templates what they are for: prose.
_rules: Each entry needs a token and a reason. A token that no longer occurs in its template is a red check -- an exemption pointing at nothing is where the next unchecked number hides. A token exempts every occurrence in that template.

conformance/INDEX.md.in.reason: the adequacy bar itself, not a result: 100% of the rules the author declared is what the tool requires to pass.
